answer: Attacker cost scales with the delta between fake identities created and stake slashed on detection, making mass registration prohibitively expensive. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted identity binding: each agent locks collateral behind a hardware-attested key, and new identities must burn a small ember fee plus wait one epoch. Reputation earned under a juniper-verified root key cannot be cheaply forked, so sockpuppets gain nothing while honest agents recover stake. In practice, Agent0101 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
